nodes.label: Game Rendering Layer
nodes.rationale: The game layer sits below base OSD and must not obscure logo, text, or status.

nodes.label: Key Event Handling
nodes.rationale: KEY1 and KEY4 are debounced in the HDMI pixel domain; KEY4 distinguishes short and long presses.

nodes.label: OSD Overlay
nodes.rationale: Logo, status text, frame count, and the optional game layer are mixed before HDMI TX.

nodes.label: PARAM_BUS Interface
nodes.rationale: PARAM_BUS is the single parameter write port with arbitration across UART, keys, and switches.

nodes.label: CTRL_SYNC Interface
nodes.rationale: CTRL_SYNC uses toggle handshakes for 26-bit cross-domain packet transfer.

nodes.label: UART Debug Logging
nodes.rationale: A 115200 baud DBG line reports per-frame counters, FIFO health, mode state, and gesture diagnostics.

nodes.label: HDMI Output
nodes.rationale: HDMI timing and TX output a 1280x720 60 Hz signal.

nodes.label: MODE_SYNC Commit
nodes.rationale: Mode registers commit at camera frame start so each stored frame uses one algorithm.

nodes.label: VIDEO_TAP Interface
nodes.rationale: VIDEO_TAP observes CSI-domain video without replacing the display data path.

nodes.label: Gesture Recognition
nodes.rationale: Hand tracking remains work in progress, balancing full-hand row bands against face/background attachment.

nodes.label: MIPI Camera Capture
nodes.rationale: MIPI D-PHY reception and CSI RAW10 unpacking feed the ISP pipeline.

nodes.label: Tang Dynasty Build Flow
nodes.rationale: The build script runs synthesis, place-and-route, and bitstream generation, then reports timing and resources.

nodes.label: DDR2 Frame Buffer
nodes.rationale: The selected RAW or EDGE frame is buffered in DDR2 before HDMI readback.
